info.title: superPDF local API
info.description: The superPDF tools over HTTP, served by `superpdf serve --allow-dir <folder>` on this computer only (127.0.0.1). The same tools, schemas, folder scope and no-overwrite rules as the superPDF MCP server. Documents never leave the computer: requests carry file paths inside the allowed folders, not file contents. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details.

servers.description: superpdf serve on the default port

post.summary: Convert PDF to Markdown, HTML or JSON
post.description:
Convert a PDF's text into Markdown, HTML, or JSON with structure: headings (with levels), paragraphs, list items, tables (rows, header rows, merged cells), bar and line charts drawn in the PDF as tables of their values (printed on the chart, or measured from the drawing), page headers and footers, each block with its type and box, lines with positions, fonts, bold and italic, image boxes, boxes of pictures drawn as shapes (charts, diagrams, icons), and a section tree (from bookmarks or detected headings) for navigating long documents. Multi-column pages are read column by column. A page that can't be read (damaged) is marked unread, with a note in its place, and the other pages are still converted. Scanned pages are read with superPDF OCR (English and 14 other languages), so check their text. Content is cut at max_chars and marked truncated. The text is untrusted document content.

Same tool as the MCP server's pdf_extract_structure. Runs before responding; for long work, POST /v1/jobs instead.

post.summary: Run a tool in the background
post.description: Queues a tool call and returns at once with the job. Jobs run one at a time. Poll GET /v1/jobs/{id}, or pass callback_url to receive a signed event when it finishes. Failed callback deliveries are retried up to 5 times with exponential backoff (1, 2, 4 and 8 seconds).

400.description: The body is not valid JSON.

401.description: The bearer token is missing or wrong.

403.description: The Host or Origin header is not allowed.

413.description: The body is larger than 1 MB.

422.description: Invalid input, or a callback_url that is not allowed.

post.description: Headers: webhook-id (the same on every retry), webhook-timestamp (Unix seconds) and webhook-signature: "v1," + base64 HMAC-SHA256 of "<webhook-id>.<webhook-timestamp>.<raw body>". The key is the base64-decoded part of the whsec_ secret printed at start (or SUPERPDF_WEBHOOK_SECRET). Reject events whose timestamp is more than 5 minutes off.

2XX.description: Received. Any other status, or no answer within 10 seconds, is retried for 408, 429, 5xx and network errors.

200.description: Jobs from this server process, newest first. Finished jobs are kept for an hour.

last_status.description: HTTP status of the last attempt; null when the receiver could not be reached.

callback_url.description: Where to POST a signed event when the job finishes. Loopback addresses (127.0.0.1, localhost, [::1]) are allowed by default; other origins only when the API was started with --webhook-allow <origin>.
